_source.scope: LIHTC law and published guidance; HUD FHA multifamily statutory limits and high cost percentages (2026); HOME per-unit subsidy limits; Florida Housing hard-cost factors; PHFA cost-rule percentages; one dated equity-price survey.
_source.high_cost_percentage_instruction: If only one geographic area is named in a given state, that area’s HCP is to be used for all localities within the state.
_source.hcp_note: HUD's notice says HOME limits must not be self-computed from HCPs: HUD tells participating jurisdictions to ask their CPD field office (HUD web page not fetchable from here; statement seen only in a search result, so not quoted).
not_obtained: State housing finance agency total-development-cost limits per unit for most of the 15 most populous states: California (CTCAC memo URL from search returned HTTP 404), Texas, New York, Illinois (cost limits sit in an Underwriting Standards Guide whose URL returned 404), Ohio, Georgia (QAP points to a Cost Limits Workbook not fetched), North Carolina, Michigan, New Jersey, Virginia (Code says limits are set annually by the authority; no table in the Code), Washington, Arizona, Massachusetts.
4 percent credit equity price: no dated figure found in a primary or named survey.
State housing tax credits, trust funds and property-tax exemptions for the 15 states (research prompt 6): not attempted here.
_source.internal_use_only: INTERNAL USE ONLY: every row here has display_allowed: false. Not published, not shown on the page, not sent to the advisor.
